title: Qwen3.8 Garbage Outputs after a few hours of use
body:
Do I have something wrong in my settings? I keep having to restart vLLM to get Qwen3.8-27b-FP8 to stop outputting nonsense / garbage. Running on an RTX Pro 6000 Max-Q.

entrypoint: ["/bin/bash", "-c"]

python3 -m vllm.entrypoints.openai.api_server \

--model Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B-FP8 \

--max-model-len 262144 \

--max-num-batched-tokens 4096 \

--gpu-memory-utilization 0.52 \

--attention-backend FLASHINFER \

--structured-outputs-config '{"backend": "xgrammar", "disable_any_whitespace": true}' \

--enable-prefix-caching \

--reasoning-parser qwen3 \

--enable-auto-tool-choice \

--tool-call-parser qwen3_coder \

--served-model-name llm-large \

--enable-chunked-prefill \

--allowed-local-media-path /app/docker_access_files \

--mm-processor-cache-type shm \

--mm-shm-cache-max-object-size-mb 512 \

--media-io-kwargs '{"video": {"num_frames": -1, "fps": 2}}' \

--override-generation-config '{"max_new_tokens": 81920, "repetition_penalty": 1.1}' \

--default-chat-template-kwargs '{"enable_thinking": true, "preserve_thinking": false, "reasoning_effort": "medium"}' \

--speculative-config '{"method":"mtp","num_speculative_tokens":2}'

I had to add --structured-outputs-config '{"backend": "xgrammar", "disable_any_whitespace": true}' \ to get structured outputs to work reliably.

I added "repetition_penalty": 1.1 to reduce garbage output and it helped but vLLM 28 seemed to make it worse again.

Are other people having this issue?

submitted by /u/trashacct383
summaryZh: 用户报告在RTX Pro 6000上运行Qwen3.8-27B-FP8时，vLLM在长时间运行后出现输出乱码的问题。讨论涉及了vLLM的复杂配置参数，包括结构化输出、推理解析器及投机采样设置，反映了当前大模型本地部署中的工程挑战。
